TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: The Mirror Year
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: Your environment reflects your own nature back at you.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body: The energy this year matches yours — which sounds great, but it's actually a test. Confidence comes easily. So does stubbornness. Watch for the moment you're sure you're right — that's the tell.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Doubling down on a belief without checking it.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Solo projects. Personal brand moves. Anything with your name on it.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: The Compete Year
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: Your drive is amplified. So is your impatience.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body: This is a high-output year. You'll want to move fast, take risks, and outwork everyone around you. That's real — but it's also a setup for burnout if you don't pace.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Competition with people who aren't actually your rivals.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Ambition that has a real target. Not just motion.

TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.name: The Creative Year
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.headline: The energy is soft and generative.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.body: This year wants you to make things. Not to grind — to create. If you let yourself, you'll produce work that surprises even you. If you fight it with structure, you'll feel stuck.
TEN_GOD_EATING_GOD.lean_into: Craft. Play. Anything that gets output out of your head.

TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.name: The Disruption Year
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.headline: You'll want to break things.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.body: This year sharpens your voice and your vision. You'll see what's broken more clearly than usual, and you'll want to say so. Used well, this is the year you change something real.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.watch_for: Saying the true thing at the wrong time. Timing is the whole game.
TEN_GOD_HURTING_OFFICER.lean_into: System-level change. Not just the complaint — the fix.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Horizon Year
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.headline: New opportunities appear and disappear fast.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.body: This year opens doors you didn't see last year. Some are real; some are mirages. Your instinct for opportunity is sharp — but so is your instinct to chase every one.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Saying yes to everything because FOMO is loud.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: One or two opportunities, done deeply.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.name: The Grounding Year
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.headline: Slow, steady, real.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.body: This isn't a dramatic year, and that's the point. What you build this year compounds for the next decade. Predictability is your advantage, not a limitation.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.watch_for: Impatience. This year rewards patience more than ambition.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_WEALTH.lean_into: Routines. Systems. Boring assets. Savings. Foundations.

TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.name: The Forge Year
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.headline: Pressure, and what you become under it.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.body: This year brings weight. Not necessarily bad — often good — but heavy. You'll be tested in ways that make you stronger if you don't collapse under the load.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.watch_for: Saying yes to responsibilities that aren't yours.
TEN_GOD_SEVEN_KILLINGS.lean_into: Rest. Real rest. Boundaries. And the people who hold you steady.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.name: The Milestone Year
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.headline: Things fall into place.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.body: This is a year where structure helps you. Promotions, credentials, commitments — the forms of success that involve other people recognizing you — are unusually available.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.watch_for: Playing small to avoid being seen.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_OFFICER.lean_into: Formal commitments. Public milestones. Showing your work.

TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.name: The Cave Year
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: Depth before output.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.body: This year pulls you inward. You'll read more, think more, want more alone time. It's not depression — it's incubation. What you plant this year becomes visible next year.
TEN_GOD_INDIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Reading. Research. Solitude. Skill-building that no one sees yet.

TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.name: The Sanctuary Year
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.headline: You get to rest and rebuild.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.body: This year is kind. Not exciting — kind. Nourishment is available if you stop trying to force productivity. The people who support you will show up if you let them.
TEN_GOD_DIRECT_RESOURCE.lean_into: Nourishment. Mentorship. Whatever refills your cup.

DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.name: The Unfolding Year
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.headline: A year still taking shape.
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.body: The energy of this year is hard to pin to a single pattern. Pay attention — the theme will reveal itself as you go.
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.watch_for: Assuming you already know what this year is about.
DEFAULT_YEAR_THEME.lean_into: Staying curious about what's actually happening.
